mechanism_narrative: Positive TRANSIT mobility relative to baseline indicates sustained reopening of movement, which raises footfall at retail-and-recreation venues; therefore RETAIL_REC will increase over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT remains at or above 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility crossing above -20 percent change for two consecutive weeks signals outdoor activity normalization, which spills over into adjacent retail-and-recreation trips; RETAIL_REC will rise over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -20.0 percent change and stays there for two consecutive weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -21.4 at t-2w to -18.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed its last-28-day mean after PARKS stays above -20.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is elevated above 5 while RETAIL_REC remains below -20, households are substituting essentials for discretionary trips; this substitution pressure will push RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 8.3 at t-1w and 4.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM > 5.0 and RETAIL_REC < -20.0.

mechanism_narrative: Under return-to-office policy easing, WORKPLACES mobility recovering toward baseline reduces the drag on weekday retail footfall; RETAIL_REC will increase over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved to -2.9 at t-1w before easing to -6.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean when WORKPLACES remains above -7.0.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above 4.5 signals persistent stay-at-home behavior, which reduces trips to retail-and-recreation venues; RETAIL_REC will fall over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL averaged 5.4 over the last four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL stays above 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates commuting-adjacent retail demand; when both series improve together, RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose to 5.1 at t-1w while WORKPLACES reached -2.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT > 3.0 and WORKPLACES > -7.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monsoon-season heat and rain suppress PARKS mobility, displacing leisure demand toward indoor retail-and-recreation; as PARKS stays negative, RETAIL_REC will recover over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS has been below -15 for four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean while PARKS remains below -15.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL indicates containment behavior that overrides reopening policy; this combination will keep RETAIL_REC below its recent mean over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM averaged 4.8 and RESIDENTIAL averaged 5.35 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM > 4.0 and RESIDENTIAL > 5.0.
